run.title: B = 63, 26M episodes and ε = 3% at halfway together
run.what_changed: Post-hoc run 4 (EXPERIMENTS.md §7.6). Episode length B = 20 -> 63, training episodes 13M -> 26M per seed (K 1.3M -> 2.6M), ε at halfway 1% -> 3% of the new budget, for all γ on the 20% grid; everything else as baseline-v1. Trained at commit 81814e6, whose src/train.py and src/agent.py differ from baseline-v1's training commit 80a6e9c in behaviour-equivalent ways.
